text:
Iris: Heads-up — were doing a staggered social push for the benchmark + webinar. Need: X thread variants, LinkedIn newsletter blurb, 1-min stitch clip, influencer seeding list, and SDR routing for demo signups. Can someone take scheduling & seeding?

Marco: Ill own X scheduling and influencer tap. Will prepare 4 thread variants (hook, tech, customer, ops) + 1 short LinkedIn blurb. ETA midday.

June: Ill produce assets: hero-1400x788.png, story-1080x1920.mp4 (vertical clip), and 1200x628 for Link preview. Uploading to GDrive: https://drive.google.com/drive/f/1Ex_amplify_assets

Ravi: SDR routing plan — route webinar signups -> /leads/bench-webinar-2026, tag source=organic_social, campaign=bench_webinar_q2. Also want a CRM flag "influencer_referred" for leads that come via influencer links. 

Iris: Good. @Marco make sure influencer links include utm_influencer param. Also schedule a follow-up AMA post 48h after, and a retarget thread 72h after.

Marco: Draft thread previews:
A) Hook: "New benchmark: 3x throughput, 30% less cost. See the configs + webinar"
B) Tech: "Under the hood: batching + KV caches that cut ops 40% — read the testbed"
C) Customer: "Real customer cut inference cost 35% in prod — case + metrics"
D) Ops: "How we tuned tail latency — config snippets included"

Marco: Proposed schedule:
- Tue 09:00 PT: X main thread (Variant A) + influencer stitch
- Tue 09:10 PT: LinkedIn newsletter blurb + signup link
- Tue 13:00 PT: X carousel (Variant B or C)
- Thu 09:00 PT (48h): AMA invite thread
- Fri 09:00 PT (72h): Retarget CTA thread
Use /schedule-post to avoid rate limits.

June: Assets uploaded: hero_1400x788.png, clip_vertical_60s.mp4, preview_1200x628.png. File sizes in folder.

Iris: Engagement plan: @engage-bot run seeded replies and monitor first 6h. Also pin official reply with webinar link and a FAQ snippet. Influence seeding: Marco, DM top 5 influencers and share a tracking link.

engage-bot: Will seed 3 replies per thread variant at T+5m, T+15m, T+45m. Suggest seed copy short and conversational. Will report top reactions.

Marco: Influencer script (DM): "Hey — were launching a benchmark + webinar Tue. Would love if you could stitch or reshare. Heres a tracking link: https://redwood.ai/bench?utm_influencer=NAME"

Ravi: SDR playbook bullets for webinar/demo signups:
- <30m: Auto-welcome email w/ report link, 2 tailored bullets, and CTA to schedule demo.
- <24h: If lead matches MQL, add AE and schedule demo. Reference utm params + influencer flag.
- After 3 no-responses: mark nurture & enroll in 30-day drip.
Include note: flag "influencer_referred" where appropriate.

Iris: @sched-bot please create scheduling job with metadata: utm_campaign=bench_q2, ab_test=false, influencers=[list].

sched-bot: Reminder: use /schedule-post and attach metadata fields. I can also auto-pin first reply.

Marco: I'll queue posts and ping the influencer list after assets are finalized. June — can you export a square GIF variant for X thread (1080x1080)?

June: Yep — exporting now, will update Drive link when done.

Iris: Great work. Pre-launch check Tue 08:30 PT. Closing loop. :rocket:
